aggregation_context.subject: Opportunity Owner
aggregation_context.logic: All metrics summed and evaluated per unique owner per period.

commission_rules.notes: Acceleration paid over Annual Target only. Applies to all SW/Services/Named Renewal revenue once threshold is crossed.
Flat rate regardless of attainment. Counts toward quota.

commission_rules.rule: Commission % - Renewals under CS (No Quota Relief)
commission_rules.notes: CS-managed renewals. 3% flat, does NOT count toward quota attainment.

accelerators.notes: Multiplier of 1.5x applied to New business amounts when owner exceeds 85% of Annual Target. Source plan text says >80% but tier table starts at 85% — using 85% as the binding threshold.
Flat 5% bonus on all Expansion product type amounts. No attainment condition.

quarterly_trigger.notes: Deferred commission carries forward quarter to quarter. To unlock deferred commission in a subsequent quarter, the accumulated target threshold (30%) must be met. All deferred commission is forfeited at year-end if the threshold is never reached.

compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.notes: Core incentive state signal. Drives tier assignment.
Ordinal encoding. Do NOT one-hot — ordinality matters.
Positive = gap to next tier. Zero if already at top tier. Key Q4 behavioral driver.

compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.formula: sum(amount, type in [SW/Services/Named Renewal], month<=cutoff) / sum(amount, month<=cutoff)
compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.notes: What fraction of revenue is acceleration-eligible. High ratio = stronger Q4 incentive to push.
Hardware is flat-rate — owners heavy in HW have weaker acceleration incentive.

compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.formula: sum(amount, type=Renewal, region=CS, month<=cutoff) / sum(amount, month<=cutoff)
compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.notes: CS renewals don't count toward quota — dilutes effective attainment.

compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.formula: count(quarters where trigger condition met, up to cutoff quarter)
compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.notes: Proxy for commission payment regularity. Owner with 0/3 has deferred income urgency.

compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.formula: count(quarters where trigger was NOT met, up to cutoff quarter)
compute_per_owner_per_cutoff_month.notes: Accumulated missed triggers. High value = strong urgency to recover in Q4.

per_deal_features.formula: lookup rate from COMMISSION_RULES by product_type + region
per_deal_features.notes: Assign each deal its applicable commission rate as an edge feature.

per_deal_features.formula: 1 if type in [Software, Services, Named Renewal] else 0
per_deal_features.notes: Binary edge flag. Separates deals that contribute to acceleration from those that don't.

feature_engineering.phase_1_note: Curriculum Phase 1 (Q1 M1+M2 → M3): cumulative_attainment_pct and tier are near-zero for all owners. These features add no discriminating signal at Phase 1. Use them from Phase 2 onwards where owner divergence begins.
